arguments.sql:
SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM main.Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.GPT >= 60
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX DESC
LIMIT 2
